question:
DRAG DROP -
Drag and drop the fields for configuring a full state backup file of the Cisco UCS Manager from the left onto the descriptions on the right.
targets: location where the backup file is stored
full path to the backup configuration file
binary file that includes a snapshot of the entire system
settings used to transfer the file to the backup server
theory: A Full State backup configuration in Cisco UCS Manager is defined by four related fields: the hostname identifies the location (server) where the backup file will be stored; the protocol specifies the settings used to transfer the file to that backup server (e.g., FTP/SCP/TFTP/SFTP); the remote file is the full path to the resulting backup configuration file on that server; and the type describes what the file actually contains — for Full State specifically, a binary file holding a snapshot of the entire system. Matching each field name to its functional role is the core of this question. (CCNP/CCIE DCCOR Official Cert Guide, Chapter 14 — UCS Configuration Management, Full State Backup Fields)
